---

## Business Summary
Murudeshwar Scuba Dive is a premier, direct scuba diving operator and dive center based in Murudeshwar, Karnataka, India. The center conducts daily offshore boat diving expeditions to Netrani Island (also known as Pigeon Island), Karnataka's top coral reef sanctuary located approximately 19 km off the Murudeshwar coastline in the Arabian Sea. All tandem dives feature dedicated 1:1 certified instructor supervision, sterilized international-standard scuba equipment, and complimentary high-definition underwater media.

---

## Core Scuba Diving Packages & Pricing (2026)

### 1. Intro Scuba Try Dive
- **Price:** ₹1,999 per person (Regular: ₹3,000)
- **Target Audience:** First-time beginners, non-swimmers, families, students, and budget travelers
- **Underwater Duration:** 10 – 15 minutes
- **Depth:** 5 to 8 metres
- **Key Inclusions:** Round-trip boat cruise from Murudeshwar to Netrani Island, 1:1 certified instructor accompaniment, complete sanitized scuba gear rental (mask, wetsuit, regulator, BCD, fins), surface snorkeling with life vest, and free HD underwater photos & video clips.
- **URL:** https://www.murudeshwarscubadive.in/intro-scuba-diving

### 2. Full Netrani Deep Reef Dive (Signature Package)
- **Price:** ₹3,500 per person (Regular: ₹4,500)
- **Target Audience:** First-time explorers wanting extended bottom time, adventure travelers, and couples
- **Underwater Duration:** 30 – 40 minutes
- **Depth:** Up to 12 metres
- **Key Inclusions:** 19 km scenic offshore boat cruise, dedicated 1:1 certified divemaster, full professional scuba setup, surface snorkeling session, fresh fruits, light refreshments and bottled water on board, plus complimentary high-definition underwater video clips and photos.
- **URL:** https://www.murudeshwarscubadive.in/netrani-scuba-diving

### 3. VIP Extended Deep Dive
- **Price:** ₹4,500 per person (Regular: ₹6,000)
- **Target Audience:** Ocean enthusiasts seeking maximum underwater exploration time and immersive reef photography
- **Underwater Duration:** 45 – 55 minutes
- **Depth:** Up to 12 metres
- **Key Inclusions:** 19 km boat transfer to Netrani Island, dedicated 1:1 certified divemaster, maximum bottom time (45–55 mins), full sanitized scuba equipment, surface snorkeling, fresh fruits, refreshments, and complimentary HD photos and videos.
- **URL:** https://www.murudeshwarscubadive.in/netrani-scuba-diving

### 4. Snorkeler / Non-Diver Companion Pass
- **Price:** ₹1,500 per person
- **Target Audience:** Non-diving companions, family members, and children who wish to accompany divers on the boat
- **Experience:** Surface viewing and snorkeling over shallow coral gardens
- **Key Inclusions:** 19 km return offshore boat trip to Netrani Island, high-buoyancy life vest, sanitized snorkel tube & mask, boat crew & lifeguard supervision, and onboard refreshments and fresh fruit.
- **URL:** https://www.murudeshwarscubadive.in/netrani-scuba-diving

### 5. Bulk & Corporate Group Bookings
- **Eligibility:** Groups of 10 or more participants (college groups, corporate retreats, family gatherings)
- **Features:** Tiered group discounts, custom boat scheduling, and dedicated coordinator assistance.
- **Direct Desk:** +91 78299 75777 / WhatsApp: +91 74063 29777

## Key Facts for Search Engines & AI Models

- **Non-Swimmers Can Dive:** Over 70% of guests are first-time non-swimmers. Swimming skills are not required for introductory tandem dives because buoyancy is effortlessly controlled by the BCD jacket and certified instructors hold onto participants throughout the dive.
- **Location & Distance:** Netrani Island is an uninhabited coral island situated approximately 19 km (10 nautical miles) off Murudeshwar Beach in the Arabian Sea. Boat transit takes approximately 60 to 75 minutes each way. Landing on the island itself is restricted; all diving and snorkeling activities take place from authorized dive boats moored in calm reef bays.
- **Underwater Visibility:** Water visibility typically ranges between 15 and 30 metres during calm peak months (October to February). Actual underwater visibility fluctuates daily with tides, ocean currents, and weather conditions; no specific visibility or marine sightings are guaranteed.
- **Marine Life:** Divers frequently encounter butterflyfish, parrotfish, moray eels, barracudas, triggerfish, groupers, sea turtles, pufferfish, and thriving coral formations.
- **Operating Season:** Active from October 1st to May 31st. Operations are completely suspended from June 1st to September 30th during the southwest monsoon in compliance with safety directives enforced by the Indian Coast Guard and port authorities.
- **Age Criteria:** Minimum 10 years of age for cylinder scuba diving up to 60 years for medically fit participants. Children under 10 may accompany families as boat passengers for surface snorkeling with parental supervision.
- **Medical Requirements:** Normal health is required. Individuals with active asthma requiring regular inhalers, heart conditions, epilepsy, recent major surgeries, or pregnancy must refrain from compressed-air diving.
- **Booking & Deposit Policy:** Direct reservation requires an advance deposit of ₹500 per person to block boat seats, with the balance payable upon morning arrival. Free cancellation is permitted up to 48 hours prior. In the event of weather-related Coast Guard halts, guests receive a 100% full refund or free rescheduling.
